newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Kia to develop model for Asian markets.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Kia to develop model for Asian markets.

text.p: Kia Motors Corp, one of South Korea's three largest carmakers, plans to develop a passenger car model for Asian markets, a company official said on Tuesday.
He said the company would build production bases in Asian countries with a combined assembly capacity of 300,000 units a year by the year 2001.
"The model will be an upgrade of the Sephia compact car or the Pride model. Its engine capacity will be less than 1.5 litres," said the official.
Production would be divided among seven countries, including China, Indonesia and Thailand, with each country supplying certain specific parts.
"Indonesia alone will have an assembling capacity of 120,000 units," the official said.
On Monday, Kia said its annual overseas production would increase to 520,000 units by 2001 from 69,042 in 1996.
Apart from the Asian production network, it also planned to produce cars in Brazil, Russia, Egypt and Poland, it said.
The company added that it would raise overall exports to 800,000 units by 2001 from 321,950 in 1996.
